+

+
+const WEGWIJZER_PATH = "/welcome";
+
+/**
+ * `/welcome/formal-request` without a step segment: sends users to the step implied by stored flow
+ * data (drafts + context), or away when the session cannot continue here.
+ */

+  const { flowState, resolvedContext } = useOnboardingFlowState();
+
+  const registrationCompletePayload = useMemo(
+    () => readOnboardingRegistrationCompletePayload(),
+    [],
+  );
+
+  const resumeStep = useMemo(
+    () => deriveFormalOnboardingResumeStep(flowState, resolvedContext),
+    [flowState, resolvedContext],
+  );
+
+  const target = useMemo(
+    () => formalOnboardingStepPath(resumeStep),
+    [resumeStep],
+  );
+
+  if (registrationCompletePayload) {
+    return <Navigate to={ONBOARDING_REGISTRATION_COMPLETE_PATH} replace />;
+  }
+
+  if (flowState.drafts.length === 0) {
+    return <Navigate to={WEGWIJZER_PATH} replace />;
+  }

Here’s what was implemented. ### Unified guest chrome in `PublicAppShell` `PublicAppShell` now wraps all `/welcome/*` routes with: - `DensityProvider` (`density="operational"`) - `PublicRegistryAppShell` with logo, `onLogin` / `loginUrl` (`PUBLIC_GUEST_LOGIN_PATH`), `WelcomePublicHeaderLeading`, `WelcomePublicHeaderTrailing`, `guestLanguagePlacement: "leading"`, and prototype registry language props from `usePublicPrototypeRegistryLanguageHeaderProps()` - `APP_FOOTER` - `ActiveInquiryContinueAlert` in a capped `max-w-7xl` strip above `` - Existing `OnboardingFlowProvider`, `PublicPrototypeLanguageProvider`, and `AlertDialogProvider` Inner routing chrome lives in `PublicGuestRegistryChrome` so hooks stay under the language provider. ```26:61:/Users/psoudan/workspace/05-Procertus/Procertus-ui-experiment/apps/frontend-pt1-extranet-onboarding/src/layouts/PublicAppShell.tsx function PublicGuestRegistryChrome() { const navigate = useNavigate(); const registryLang = usePublicPrototypeRegistryLanguageHeaderProps(); return ( ), onLogin: () => navigate(PUBLIC_GUEST_LOGIN_PATH), loginUrl: PUBLIC_GUEST_LOGIN_PATH, leadingActions: , trailingActions: , guestLanguagePlacement: "leading", ...registryLang, }} footer={APP_FOOTER} >
); } ``` ### Pages no longer repeat the registry shell - **`WegwijzerPage`** — only the `max-w-7xl` body (hero + explorer). - **Traject / triage / placeholders** — use **`TrajectPageFrame`** (no inner `PublicRegistryAppShell`). - **Info / expert call** — still use **`DensityProvider density="spacious"`** around `ExpertCallBookingView` only; the outer shell stays operational. ### `TrajectLayout` vs `TrajectPageFrame` (`ui-certification`) - **`TrajectPageFrame`** — shared title column + sticky action bar (same as before, minus shell). - **`TrajectLayout`** — Storybook / standalone: `PublicRegistryAppShell` + `TrajectPageFrame` (unchanged story API). ### Formal onboarding without double shell - **`OnboardingShell`** — `embedded?: boolean`; when true, renders only the inner `PageHeader` + children (no registry shell). - **`OnboardingFlowView`** — `embeddedRegistryShell?: boolean` plumbed through. - **`CustomerOnboardingFlow`** — sets `embeddedRegistryShell`, drops duplicate header/language props (shell owns them). ### Routing - **`PublicWelcomeOnboardingSessionLayout`** removed; routes are direct children of `PublicAppShell`. - **`PublicWelcomeOnboardingSessionLayout.tsx`** deleted. `bun run build` for `apps/frontend-pt1-extranet-onboarding` completes successfully. +/**

content.text:
### Cause

On guest routes, `apps/frontend-pt1-extranet-onboarding/src/index.css` moves scrolling to **`html`** (`overflow-y: auto` on `html[data-public-layout]`).

`TrajectPageFrame` still picked the **first** ancestor with `overflow-y: auto` — the `PublicRegistryAppShell` root. In practice the page scroll happens on **`documentElement`**, so that shell node often never scrolls (`scrollTop` stays `0`, `scrollHeight` ≈ `clientHeight`). The code always treated that as “at bottom”, kept `hasContentBelow` false, and the fade stayed at **`opacity-0`** in both themes.

### Fix

Scroll-root detection in ```74:138:/Users/psoudan/workspace/05-Procertus/Procertus-ui-experiment/packages/ui-certification/src/components/traject/TrajectLayout.tsx``` now:

1. Walks ancestors with `overflow: auto | scroll | overlay` but **only uses** them if `scrollHeight > clientHeight + 2` (they actually scroll).
2. Otherwise uses **`document.documentElement`** (and listens on **`window`** for scroll).
3. If nothing qualifies yet (layout still settling), it **still** attaches document scroll + resize observers so the gradient can appear once content grows.

The gradient styling (`bg-linear-to-t from-card`) was fine; only the visibility gate was wrong.
